title: review-run run settings
description: The settings.json of a run directory (Run settings): every key of the Config table resolved for the run with its origin, except hooks, retention, escalation_ttl and me, the plugin directories passed, the plugin directory hash, the config hash and the effective permission profile's kind and hash. Written once at run order step 4 (mode 0600); every later step reads it and never the current config or environment. limits keys appear individually as limits.<key>.

plugin_dirs.description: Realpaths of the plugin directories passed to the launch, sorted: the bundled plugin and, when the skill comes from another plugin, that plugin.

config_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, ASCII) of every resolved value of the run, flags and hooks included.
